Simple Organizer is a Python-based application for automatic file organization on Linux and Windows. It offers features like sub-categorization, a rules engine, undo functionality, scheduling, and duplicate detection/deletion, all designed for safety and reliability with no internet or background services required.

EdenText is a powerful, free, and open-source web-based word processor designed for local-first operation. It allows users to create and edit documents in .docx and .odt formats directly in their browser, ensuring privacy as all processing happens client-side and documents never leave the user's computer. It aims to provide a rich feature set comparable to desktop applications while being accessible via a single URL or as a slim offline app.

The apex-parser repository is a Python-based tool designed to parse and manage lists of proxy servers. It categorizes proxies into whitelist, blacklist, and a full list, offering them in various formats like Base64, Plain, and YAML. The project aims to facilitate internet freedom by providing access to functional proxy lists.
